standard.summary: 期望的梯度信噪比（Gradient Signal-to-Noise Ratio）目标值。默认 5.0。
standard.effect: GSNR 高于目标 → 可适当提高 LR；GSNR 低于目标 → 降低 LR。
standard.whenToUse: 开启 ac_enable_auto_lr_adjustment 后设置。5.0 是 LoRA 训练的经验合理范围。
standard.avoidWhen: 没有 GSNR 监控经验时不建议调整，保持默认。

standard_en.summary: Target value for the gradient signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR). Default 5.0.
standard_en.effect: GSNR above the target means the LR can go up; below the target means it should come down.
standard_en.whenToUse: Set it after enabling ac_enable_auto_lr_adjustment. 5.0 is the empirically sensible range for LoRA training.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep the default unless you have experience reading GSNR.

advanced.principle: GSNR = E[‖g‖²] / Var[g]，刻画梯度的信号质量。工业训练常见范围 1~20。LoRA 由于参数少，GSNR 通常比全量微调高。
advanced.tradeoffs: 目标值需要根据实际训练 GSNR 曲线校准，初始建议先观察几次训练的 GSNR 范围再设定目标。

advanced_en.principle: GSNR = E[‖g‖²] / Var[g], characterizing gradient signal quality. Common industrial-training range is 1~20. LoRA, with few parameters, usually has higher GSNR than full fine-tuning.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The target must be calibrated against the actual training GSNR curve; initially, observe the GSNR range across a few runs before setting a target.
